name: Clerk
tagline: Developer-first authentication and user management API for modern apps
description: Clerk provides authentication, user management, and session APIs for web and mobile apps. It covers sign-up, sign-in, organizations, and backend user administration with SDKs and REST endpoints so developers can ship secure auth without building it from scratch.

auth.details: Secret key via Authorization: Bearer sk_... header for Backend API; publishable key for frontend SDKs. Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Hobby: free with up to 50,000 MRU (Monthly Retained Users) per app; Pro from $25/mo ($20/mo annual) with 50,000 MRU included per app, then published overages (from $0.02/MRU); see clerk.com/pricing

rate_limits: Backend API: production 1,000 req/10s; development 100 req/10s; some endpoints have lower limits. See clerk.com/docs/guides/how-clerk-works/system-limits
use_cases: create a user via backend API
